app.home.title: Digital Driver License
app.home.subtitle: Proof of Concept
app.home.description: This site is a proof of concept that invites you to explore the technical concepts and technologies enabling the issuance of verifiable credentials of a digital driver's license.
app.conditions.title: Conditions of use
app.conditions.description.p1: This site is a proof of concept for a verifiable credential issuance service that is NOT intended for production use. The purpose of this service is to demonstrate what a verifiable digital driver's license credential might look like when issued by a government entity, such as the Government of Quebec. Such a credential is a reliable digital version containing information typically provided by governments on physical media, like a driver's license. In a real-world version of such an issuing service, individuals would need to undergo an identity verification process before the verifiable credential is issued to them. The information contained in the credential would come directly from the competent authority.
app.conditions.description.p2: The verifiable credential generated by this service is only usable with this proof of concept and is not intended for production use. This service is based on an open-source application that allows for easy deployment of this verifiable credential issuer. Any questions regarding this service or the project can be addressed via the {repoexpmdl}. Contributions to the project are also welcome!
app.conditions.description.p3: Please do not use your personal information in this service. This is not a production service, and the data you provide should not be based on your own personal information. The information collected is simply what you enter in the form for exploratory purposes for this proof of concept, and it is reset regularly.
app.conditions.description.p4: If you have any questions about this service or our collection or use of personal information, please direct your inquiries to the gouvernment identity credentials team

app.warning.title: Need of a Digital Wallet
app.warning.p1.1: The goal of this proof of concept is to demonstrate the
app.warning.p1.2: issuance of a digital driver license
app.warning.p1.3: that will be received on a digital wallet. The installation of a digital wallet on your device will allow you to scan the QR code generated for the digital credential's issuance.
app.warning.p2: In the context of our experimentation, we worked with two types of digital driver license.
app.warning.quebec.driver.license.title: For the Quebec driver license:
app.warning.quebec.driver.license.p1: These wallets allow you to receive the digital driver license for the Quebec standards.
app.warning.quebec.driver.license.wallet: : Available for both iOS and Android devices, you can find the installation program in the following links:
: Still in development, you can find it in it's GitHub repository to install and run it on your PC. However, this option may require technical skills.
app.warning.international.driver.license: : This wallet allows you to receive the digital driver license for the international standard ISO/IEC 18013-5.
Still in development, you can find it in it's GitHub repository to install and run it on your PC. However, this option may require technical skills.
Also, this wallet is only available for Android devices for the moment.
app.warning.p3: We thank you for your interest in this proof of concept and remain at your disposal for any additional questions.
